title: Project configuration
description: The project's own configuration, stored at .atrio/config.json (ADR-014): identity, the blocking minimum the scaffold collected at init, the declared environments and providers, and the versions the core needs to migrate the project safely.

description.description: The project's purpose. Part of the scaffold's blocking minimum: init does not proceed without it (01-definicion-producto.md, scaffold minimum).

artifactLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the project's artifacts are written in. Set at project creation and immutable afterwards; that immutability is enforced by the core comparing this document across versions, not by this schema.

environments.description: The project's deployment environments. Defaults to dev, staging, prod when none are supplied at initialization; mutable afterwards. A task's closureEnvironment must name one of these entries, but that cross-artifact check belongs to the core, not to this schema.

layers.description: The system's layers. A layer's folder is only created once its blocking definition — stack and applicationType — is set, not merely on the layer's name.

providers.description: The agent CLI providers configured for this project, e.g. claude-code.

platformVersion.description: The Atrio version that created, or last migrated, this project.

schemaVersions.description: Schema generation in use, per artifact type (e.g. task, decision). Lets the core migrate artifacts selectively instead of forcing every artifact type to the latest generation at once.

layer.description: One layer of the system: what it is called, the stack it runs on, and the kind of application it is.

provider.description: One agent CLI provider available to this project.
